name: cfcmt-bus-executed-action-eval-v1

evaluation.test_separation: New fixed demand/SUMO seed realizations, disjoint from fit/stop/calibrate; same pinned timetable and generated route corridors.
evaluation.comparison: Three training seeds, three paired generated demand days; retain every branch/day/seed and compare all-seed means.
evaluation.completion: Report completion rate and departed/completed counts alongside cost.
evaluation.interpretation: Bounded pilot on one target city; no population-level CI or city removal.

checkpoint_rule: Reuse all six existing exported adapted policy.pt artifacts without changes; previously verified equal to the original final adapted actors. No checkpoint/seed selection.
intervention: Only learned-policy deployment mapping changes. Interpret output as desired physical execution, project normalized action onto [g_s(-1),g_s(+1)]. Preserve the original guard reachable range and floors. Do not apply the proposal transform a second time.
baseline_rule: Reuse original rule, zero-proposal and original source/local adapted results, with their original proposal mapping.
admission: All12288 target fit executed labels must be unchanged by the projection, including2010 labels shrunk by the old repeated guard; repeated projection must be identical.
data_boundary: No new data, H5 edits or replay loading in evaluation. Keep CFCMT-owned source physical execution labels; do not access mutable Thesis.
decision: Retain all18 cases and every seed; report mean, per-seed and paired costs, wait/ride, completion and actual holding. No parameter, floor, threshold, data or model changes after seeing results.
limitations: These are three previously analyzed generated demand cases in one corridor city, not prospective confirmation.
The learned mapping changes inside the same reachable action range; the executor is not byte-for-byte identical.
This evaluates already fitted55k IQL actors only. SAC/model continuation would also need aligned actor actions in Q/WM queries and backups before reuse.
Source and target retain different dynamics and target update exposure; this does not isolate normalized confidence or prove general cross-city superiority.
